title: Factory Droid client <-> daemon protocol
description: Index of the complete protocol: every definition is a $ref into the part that owns it (shared.schema.json, droid.schema.json, daemon.schema.json). Load all four files to resolve any #/definitions/<Name> through this document, or load only the parts you need (a droid exec client needs shared + droid). Generated from the Zod schemas in @factory/droid-sdk-core. Every distinct protocol schema is a definition, named after its most upstream export; reference one with #/definitions/<Name>. Request definitions carry x-factory-response (and/or x-factory-result) naming their response definition. Wire frames are expressed as allOf: [{$ref: JsonRpcEnvelopeSchema}, {frame-specific properties}]. Values marked x-factory-runtime-only are validated more strictly at runtime than this document can express.
